added.summary: A field's HTML `type`: password (masked, uncopyable, with a reveal toggle `<id>/Reveal` dressed `<component>.reveal[revealed]`), number (filters typed characters), email, url, tel and search. A number, email or url that is not one is invalid; documents write `<field type="password">` and style it with `:invalid`.
The virtual keyboard a field asks for (HTML `inputmode`); unset, its type's. The web shell gives a one-line field a hidden <input> with it.
A field's autofill hint (HTML `autocomplete`), passed to the page's input.
